He has a kind, tired face, deeply drawn wrinkles, bushy gray eyebrows, a full white beard and mustache, and wisps of gray hair beneath a broad, loosely woven straw hat. His faded dusty-blue button-up work shirt has an open collar, a small chest pocket, rolled sleeves, and subtle stains. > Large dilapidated wooden houses line the left side of the lane, with warped planks, faded shutters, dark open doorways, shallow stone steps, and irregular terracotta roof tiles.
